records.actual_author: Current ledger assembly; Fermi and Newton independently reviewed the finished prose
records.review_scope: Current static visitor copy, metadata, captions and accessible labels; exact raw source and published-text hashes. Rendered and release acceptance are separate.
records.review_standard: The exact current visitor prose, captions and narrative structure were independently reviewed by Fermi and Newton under the current warm-prose and disclosure mandates. Newton reviewed visible labels and image alt attributes; a separate bounded review covered title, description and Open Graph metadata voice, reusing prior research for factual support. Earlier historical/source research is reused for unchanged material; changed captions and quotations were checked against the cited sources. This is not a fresh exhaustive review of all retained claims. Rendered context, artwork identity and ownership, complete CI and release acceptance remain separate. A separate Newton source-voice review inspected nonempty static alt, aria-label, placeholder and title attributes; dynamic attributes, usability and full accessibility remain separate.
